entities.name: Chinese Ancestor Veneration
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The Shang Dynasty formalized ancestral veneration — the belief that dead family members influence the living. Families made regular offerings of food, drink, and "spirit money" at ancestral altars. The Qingming (Tomb Sweeping) Festival brought entire families to clean graves and present offerings.
